transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name], and I'll be conducting your evaluation today. Can you tell me what brings you in or what's been on your mind lately that made you decide to come here?

I guess... my sister told me I needed to come. She says I'm acting different. 

I don't really know how to explain it, but my body just feels out of my control lately. Like, a while ago, I was pacing around the apartment all night. Just walking and making all these notes for a supper-club idea. But now... I don't know. I'm just really slowed down. My sister says it takes me forever just to get my shoes on. 

So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you ever experienced a time when your mood was unusually high, irritable, or you felt like you had a lot more energy than usual, even to the point of not needing much sleep?

Um... yeah, I guess. A little while ago, after I got fired... I didn't really feel bad about it. I actually felt... I don't know, weirdly unstoppable. Just really excited. 

But... if anyone questioned my plans, or... told me to slow down... I'd get really mad. I'd kind of blow up at them. It just felt like they were trying to ruin my life.
During that time when you felt really excited and unstoppable, did you find that you didn’t need as much sleep as usual?
Yeah... I guess so. I didn't really sleep much. Maybe... a couple hours a night? I didn't feel tired, though.
During that time when you felt really excited and unstoppable, did you find yourself doing things very quickly, starting a lot of projects, or feeling like you couldn’t sit still?

Yeah, I guess. I just... I had a lot of energy. 

I couldn't really sit still. Like, if I tried to watch a game or even just eat, I'd have to get up. I just kept pacing around or... making phone calls. Sketching out menus for that club idea. Reorganizing the kitchen. Stuff like that. I just had to keep moving.
How long did you feel that way — really excited, unstoppable, not sleeping much, and full of energy?
I don't know exactly. Maybe... a week or two? It's hard to remember. It just lasted for a while.
After that period of feeling really excited and full of energy, did you experience a time when you felt very down, depressed, or lost interest in things for several days or more?

Yeah... I guess so. Everything just kind of... stopped. 

I don't know. The stuff that usually keeps me steady... cooking, music, pickup soccer... even taking food photos or volunteering... it just feels flat now. Like... I know I used to care about all that. I just... I can't make myself feel it anymore.
How long did you feel that way — very down, losing interest in things — after the period when you felt really excited and full of energy?
I don't know... it's been a while. Maybe... three months? Yeah, about three months of just feeling heavy and... slow.
Have you ever had another time in your life when you felt extremely energetic, unusually confident, or unusually irritable, even if it didn’t last very long?
No... I don't think so. Just that one time, I guess. I don't really remember anything else like that.
How long did you feel very down and lose interest in things — was it at least two weeks?
Yeah... I mean, I just said it's been like three months. So... yeah. Definitely longer than two weeks.
